_note: Copy this file to profile.local.json and replace the fictional 'Alex Rivera'
placeholder values below with your own. profile.local.json is gitignored, so
your real name, contact details, and history stay out of version control.
jobfill never invents facts about you, so leave any field you don't have a
real answer for as an empty string, empty array, or false — it is then left
blank on a form rather than guessed.
The eeo block is optional and holds special-category data (gender, race,
veteran status, disability). It is sent to Anthropic only as part of a
form-fill mapping prompt and never leaves your machine otherwise. Leaving
it empty is fine: a form's demographic questions are then answered with
a decline/prefer-not-to-say option where the form offers one, and skipped
Once the helper is running, profile.local.json can also be edited from the
dashboard settings tab at http://127.0.0.1:7877/#settings instead of by hand.
